the Cloud model gateway's https origin the core engine's agents call AI through (no path or credentials); empty (the default, or none) leaves the core engine refusing work. Set coreEngine.agentModel too

the model every core engine step runs on through the model gateway: an Anthropic model id, such as claude-sonnet-4-6, or any model the gateway offers (checked live), such as zai.glm-5; empty (the default, or none) leaves the core engine refusing work. Set coreEngine.modelGatewayUrl too

none (the default): this install's workers do not run test services; mirrored: the five starter image copies were made and checked (scripts/test-services-mirror.ts --verify), so workers pull them at boot and run test services
on: enable saved environment images after the control plane publishes all three image roles and the registry template; off (the default): keep saved environments disabled

bridge (the default): task sandboxes and devcontainers reach the internet through the worker host's own network, as before; gateway: the commands the agent runs (shell, setup, checks, install steps, the dev container's own processes) sit on an internal network whose only exit is the host's egress gateway (the install's DNS list applies, raw IP connections and the push-capable registries are refused, S3 is refused unless a project lifts a bucket); a worker whose gateway cannot start does not boot. The image build steps of a dev container (Dockerfile RUN, features) and the end-to-end verifier's build commands go out the same way, and Docker's default bridge is walled. The Docker daemon's own build fetches (`ADD <url>`, a `FROM` base image, a dev container's features) and the host's own image pulls go through the gateway's daemon proxy: only names the install's DNS list allows, no raw addresses, no S3 buckets (packages/worker/ec2/README.md, Sandbox egress gateway). Not covered: what the install's DNS list allows (github.com push, Slack and Atlassian web APIs, a project's additions and lifted S3 buckets) and Rovara's own services. Takes effect for workers booted after the change (named environments only)

the model the hosted Just answer and the start-box classifier run on through the model gateway (not coding tasks, which keep coreEngine.agentModel): an Anthropic model id, such as claude-haiku-5-5; empty (the default, or none) uses coreEngine.agentModel, as before

the model the hosted lessons learn with (the reflector and the judges) through the model gateway, on the company's own Anthropic account (not coding tasks, which keep coreEngine.agentModel): an Anthropic model id, such as claude-haiku-5-5; empty (the default, or none) uses claude-haiku-5-5; a company may choose its own in its AI settings, which wins for that company
enabled: an admin may confirm a change from an AI tool in the tool's own pop-up; disabled: only the Slack Confirm button or the CLI

enabled: Code's company layer is on (company membership sign-in, invites, Add to Slack, Slack company mode); disabled (the default): it is off, and the template holds no company-only grant. Close self-serve (company.selfServe disabled) and migrate the members before enabling it (named environments only)

description: enabled: a person with an operator's invite code may create their own company, only while company.signIn is enabled too; disabled (the default): self-serve create is refused, whatever the stored self-serve setting says (named environments only)

enabled: Slack workspaces other than the install's own use their company's own bot token and company checks, only while company.signIn is enabled too; disabled (the default): only the install's workspace is served, as before (named environments only)

description: on: each company picks its core engine model from the models the gateway offers it (setup's AI and spending step), coreEngine.agentModel being the default; off (the default): every company runs coreEngine.agentModel (named environments only)
